narrative.overview: The owner supplied a dark agency reference (Trebuto) and asked the page to follow it everywhere except the magnifier animation (hero, lens chapter, results chapter) and the footer, which stay as designed. The result is a black page of dark grey cards with 1px light lines, hot pink as the action color, orange and purple as supporting accents, and one typeface. A single fixed three.js stage (chrome magnifier, link graph, recoloured to pink, purple and orange) runs behind the hero, lens and results chapters; the later sections are ordinary opaque-card sections on the black ground. The results chapter alone sits on paper.
keyCharacteristics: Black ground (#0b0e13), grey cards (#17171c, #1f1f26) with a 1px light line.
Pink fills for action; each accent has a fill value and a lighter text value for use on dark.
One family: Archivo, variable weight and width. No serif, no italic, no monospace.
Section titles upper case, centered, with a short pink bar beneath.
Pill buttons; cards 8-20px radius; coloured top or side bars as the card signature.
Hero carries a pink/purple radial glow at the upper right.
The stage degrades: reduced motion gives a still layout; no WebGL leaves the page unchanged.

rules.name: The Pink Action Rule
rules.body: Pink fills mean "act or selected". Orange is a second button color only for the "see more" actions; purple never fills a button.

rules.name: The Text Value Rule
rules.body: On dark, accent colors appear as text only in their -text value, never the fill value.

rules.name: The Paper Chapter Rule
rules.body: Only the results chapter sits on paper; there the accent word is ink with a pale pink (#ffc2d9) underline highlight.

rules.name: The Labelled Sample Rule
rules.body: Illustrative rankings, numbers and results are labelled "Örnek gösterim".

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo only; no serif, italic, monospace or third face.

rules.name: The Upper-Case Title Rule
rules.body: Section titles are upper case with one pink word; hero and the lens, results and closing headings are sentence case.

rules.name: The Two Lines Rule
rules.body: Headings run at most two lines (text-wrap: balance, ch max-width, smaller step on phones).

rules.name: The Tonal Card Rule
rules.body: Cards are solid grey on black and separated by a 1px line, not by shadow.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are large, offset-down, negative-spread, black; no hard offset shadows.

dos: Do use the brand name "Denizli SEO" and the primary label "Ücretsiz SEO analizi iste" everywhere.
Do label every illustrative figure, ranking or result "Örnek gösterim".
Do keep the © OpenStreetMap credit on the map and in the footer.
Do use only real content: project screenshots and names, and the Google rating 5,0 from 28 reviews.
Do keep headings to two lines, with the smaller title step on phones.
Do keep the visible 3px pink focus ring and 44px minimum targets.
Do degrade the stage: reduced motion gives a still layout; no WebGL leaves the page unchanged.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, client or partner logos, statistics, case studies, awards or ranking guarantees; the reference's versions were deliberately not copied.
Don't add a second typeface, italic, monospace or an eyebrow above a heading.
Don't fill a button with purple, or use a fill-value accent as small text on dark.
